news_mentions.headline: Broncos vs. Chiefs: Three must-know storylines for Monday's Week 1 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack breaks down three must-know storylines in Thursday night's game between the Denver Broncos and Kansas City Chiefs.
news_mentions.body_text: monday night football opens up with a doozy pitting the reigning afc west champions against the squad that dominated the division with nine straight first place finishes before finally losing the throne how will the broncos fare at long last being chased rather than acting as the chasers denver topped the afc west in 2025 and finished as the top seed in the conference by going 14 3 despite their mighty record they ll kick off the new campaign fighting against a regression narrative the broncos had 11 one possession wins last year tying the 2024 chiefs and 2022 vikings two clubs that would go on to miss the playoffs the following season for the most in nfl history their opponents the chiefs will be looking to pick themselves back up after a shocking six win campaign that marked their first losing season since 2012 was it a true sign of the end or simply the setup to a redemptive chapter in kansas city s dynasty beating the broncos who bested them in a pair of one possession games last year would nudge the answer toward the latter these two teams will meet again in week 8 when we have a much clearer picture of where their seasons are heading but first they ll have a chance to set the tone in a star studded week 1 finale three must know storylines 1 both qbs are coming off major injuries patrick mahomes is set to make his much anticipated return after tearing his acl in week 15 last season his reward for working his way back to the field in roughly nine months facing a ferocious denver defense that has led the league in sacks for two straight years he will also be without left tackle josh simmons due to a back injury putting undrafted rookie kahlil benson in line to serve as his blindside blocker it s a heck of a test but the two time most valuable player is as capable as anyone of working his way through it whereas mahomes didn t play at all in the preseason bo nix suited up for two drives in denver s second preseason game as part of his process of coming back from a broken ankle suffered in the divisional round he looked comfortable in the limited action going 6 of 9 for 76 yards and a touchdown but he wasn t required to move around a ton and test out his mobility it ll be the real deal against the chiefs who will do their best to flush him out and make him uncomfortable 2 broncos chiefs taking different backfield approaches denver enters the season with a deep versatile running back room j k dobbins and rj harvey who combined for 1 705 scrimmage yards and 16 scores last season are back atop the depth chart dobbins is the better all around back but he s struggled to stay on the field throughout his career as evidenced by the running back missing the broncos final nine games last season including playoffs he nonetheless led the team in rushing yards as harvey proved dynamic in the passing game but took time to find his footing they won t be powering denver s ground game alone though despite being listed third on the depth chart rookie jonah coleman has the talent to carve out a role sooner rather than later giving sean payton three ball carriers with which to attack kansas city s front the chiefs are likely to feature more of a solo act after missing out on playing in the super bowl for just the second time in seven years they signed the super bowl lx mvp kenneth walker it s been a while since andy reid s chiefs utilized a true workhorse running back such as when kareem hunt shouldered the load during his first stint in kansas city or jamaal charles spearheaded the attack during reid s early years with the club both produced tremendous results and now 2026 figures to be the kwiii show he ll play a vital role in helping the offense function at a high level while patrick mahomes gets fully back to himself 3 broncos upgraded passing attack vs chiefs new look secondary after finishing last season with an offense that ranked just above average 14th in points scored the broncos went out and traded for an x factor jaylen waddle the perception of waddle might have taken a bit of a hit first as he took a backseat to tyreek hill in miami and then as the dolphins offense waned in effectiveness the past couple years but he is a highly efficient pass catching weapon in three of the past four seasons waddle has finished as a top 15 wr in yards per route twice ranking in the top six per nfl pro he is the perfect complement to courtland sutton and there were rave reviews of pat bryant out of camp too the trio s task will be to dismantle a kansas city secondary transformed by the offseason the chiefs defense lost six players who started 10 plus games last season including safety bryan cook cornerback jaylen watson and cb trent mcduffie k c let the former two walk in free agency and traded mcduffie to the rams part of a recurring strategy by general manager brett veach to reshuffle his secondary rather than pay big money extensions he did the same in 2024 with l 39 jarius sneed who is back and joined by 2026 no 6 overall pick mansoor delane and free agent signing alohi gilman as part of the new look defensive backfield the difference in the game could come down to which revamped group starts the season stronger

news_mentions.headline: Broncos' Courtland Sutton: Bo Nix has been 'like a mountain lion' awaiting his Week 1 return
news_mentions.description: With all the attention on Patrick Mahomes returning for the Kansas City Chiefs on Monday night at Arrowhead Stadium, Bo Nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat, but the Denver Broncos quarterback feels ready to roll.
news_mentions.body_text: with all the attention on patrick mahomes returning for the kansas city chiefs on monday night at arrowhead stadium bo nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat the denver broncos quarterback missed the afc championship game after suffering a right ankle fracture late in a divisional round win over buffalo the prevailing theory is that had nix been healthy the broncos would have been playing in santa clara for the super bowl in february the qb has been cleared for most of the offseason last month he participated in 14 preseason snaps dipping his toe in the water nix s full return comes monday night in prime time as the broncos set out to defend their afc west title i m just excited to get out there nix said via the team s official website i feel like i m pacing and feel like i ve been in this practice schedule for a long time it s exciting to go out there and play another team it s really exciting and i know that our guys are going to respond well i feel like i have a great group with me that i m going in here with i can t wait in two seasons nix has not missed a passing snap in his regular season career and denver was the only team not to have a backup qb attempt a pass in 2024 and 2025 per nfl research receiver courtland sutton said nix s eagerness to return is obvious he s a competitor now sutton said i m looking forward to watching him go out there he s like a mountain lion that s in the zoo that s just pacing i saw a mountain lion at the colorado zoo he was just pacing back and forth and i was like y all don t want that boy to get out it s not going to be good that s what bo reminds me of nix has led the broncos to 24 career wins tied for the most over a player s first two seasons since 1950 russell wilson denver is 3 1 versus the chiefs with nix as a starter having lost the first matchup before taking the next three the club was 1 15 versus k c from 2016 2023 before drafting nix in 2024 the afc west champs starting the season off on the road won t be an easy first step in their effort to repeat but it s probably better to play mahomes at arrowhead early in his return rather than later

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 1 picks: Upset and score predictions, matchup breakdowns for every game
news_mentions.description: Can Josh Allen and the Bills flip the script on the Texans' ferocious defense? Do the Buccaneers or Bengals prevail in a potential shootout? Will the Cowboys get off on the right foot against the Giants? Check out the Week 1 game picks!
news_mentions.body_text: nfl com editors jeremy bergman brooke cersosimo gennaro filice bobby kownack and dan parr will predict the winner of every game in the 2026 nfl season using the unbeatable combo of football analysis and excessive punctuation check out their week 1 nfl picks below notes the lines provided by fanduel are locked as of 1 p m et on wednesday sept 9 stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl sunday sept 13 why dan picked the bears i ve already planted my flag with the bears particularly caleb williams and ben johnson heading into their follow up to an exhilarating first year together i m not going to back down now that week 1 is finally here my pick is largely tied to belief in johnson s offense and my continued skepticism about a bryce young led attack being able to score enough to consistently win yes there s been a lot of hand wringing about whether the bears truly have upgraded their defense which allowed the fourth most yards in the league last season and made taking the ball away its signature a risky way of doing business from year to year i m not sure the panthers are prepared to fully take advantage of chicago s weakness with questions of their own at offensive tackle now carolina spent big on defense this offseason with the signings of lb devin lloyd and olb jaelan phillips if ejiro evero s crew comes out guns blazing and never lets williams settle in things could easily swing in the home team s favor unfortunately the panthers will be without the player who was supposed to be phillips top running mate off the edge as carolina s sacks co leader from last season nic scourton is out for the season with an acl tear if the game does turn into a shootout a distinct possibility i m leaning toward i like the bears chances a bit better why bobby picked the bengals cincinnati admittedly seems to have a bit of an early season curse the bengals finally broke a three year week 1 losing streak in 2025 only for joe burrow to suffer a long term toe injury the following game however burrow has been healthy and striking an optimistic tone in the lead up to the new season stating he s trying to manifest a return to the super bowl and can feel this bengals squad is different in my bones i believe him buccaneers versus bengals figures to be one of the most explosive matchups of the nfl s opening week cincinnati has more firepower comparatively and the offense should be able to hit the ground running the healthy core of burrow ja 39 marr chase tee higgins and chase brown is as consistent as it gets while tampa bay needs to shake off last season s collapse and figure out how to best find success in the post mike evans era with emeka egbuka toe and jalen mcmillan knee both coming back from injuries there are likely still some growing pains to work through in that process which could allow for cincy s rebuilt dexter lawrence led defense to provide burrow with just enough of a buffer why gennaro picked the lions immediately following a disappointing 2025 season that saw detroit quadruple its loss total from 2024 dan campbell gave himself a freaking f and stressed that the lions needed to get that hunger back earlier this week campbell said new orleans is a hungry opponent so whose appetite will be satiated on sunday the lions feast at ford field as the league s highest scoring home team in three of the past four seasons including the 25 campaign in fact detroit dropped a 50 burger on chicago in last year s home opener and while it s reasonable to be concerned about the lions offensive line it s equally reasonable to be underwhelmed by the saints d line now new orleans second year signal caller tyler shough might take advantage of detroit s depleted secondary points could be plentiful i just see the lions getting a bigger fill new oc drew petzing enjoys a splashy debut with detroit s high end collection of playmakers allowing lions fans to overzealously tell anyone who ll listen that they re totally over ben johnson why gennaro picked the texans david vs goliath is always fun but how about goliath vs goliaths that s how this wildly enticing opener feels to me with preseason mvp front runner josh allen taking on the baddest defense on the planet granted buffalo also boasts the reigning nfl rushing king james cook a brand new wr1 dj moore and a highly cohesive offensive line but i m still backing the texans loaded d after all demeco ryans crew has gotten the best of allen in each of the past two seasons holding the quarterback to a career low 30 percent completions in 2024 and subjecting him to a career high eight sacks in 2025 both of those texans wins came in houston where this sunday s tilt will take place oh and for buffalo s offensive play caller joe brady this happens to be his first real game as a head coach at any level learning to manage the dual roles of hc and oc is a challenging task to begin with now try performing that juggling act in the face of will anderson and his ferocious friends as someone who just picked buffalo to win the super bowl i have the highest possible hopes for these bills over the long haul but finding an offensive groove takes time in week 1 give me the home team with the hellacious defense why dan picked the ravens while the colts had the epic collapse losing seven straight games to close out last season both teams are going to be eager to remove the bitter taste of a disappointing 2025 from their mouths first year ravens head coach jesse minter has an opportunity to prove his worth right away against an offense that scored in bunches when qb daniel jones was healthy last year minter needs no reminder of that fact as the colts went on the road and dropped 38 on his chargers in week 7 the most points allowed by the bolts all season can the defensive guru avenge that loss with his new crew on paper he has the weaponry to make it happen it will certainly help if jones is at all rusty in his first game back since tearing his achilles in december the biggest question for ball knowers around the league though is whether lamar jackson has his swagger back after not performing to his usual standard much in an injury plagued 2025 will new oc declan doyle previously ben johnson s apprentice launch a rejuvenated jackson into orbit against a long struggling colts defense that didn t add much sizzle in the offseason maybe it s wishful thinking but i d like to believe the two time mvp still has enough in the tank to outlast a frisky indy offense why bobby picked the jaguars there aren t a ton of logical paths to a cleveland victory the browns turned back to deshaun watson who was outplayed by shedeur sanders in the preseason but nonetheless won the starting job production from the wide receiver room will depend heavily on rookies kc concepcion and denzel boston mastering the learning curve while running back quinshon judkins is coming off a serious season ending injury oh and cleveland s defense is without myles garrett for the first time in a decade it s a lot for newbie head coach todd monken and his rookie defensive coordinator mike rutenberg to juggle the jaguars conversely are looking to build on a 13 win season trevor lawrence found his stride under coach liam coen and now enters year 2 in the system with a loaded pass catching group jacksonville s defense also boasts playmakers at every level considering where the jaguars see their 2026 season going they shouldn t run into much trouble hosting the browns why jeremy picked the steelers one of these teams is comfortable in its own skin the other has zero identity at the most important position in sports mike mccarthy and kevin stefanski both enter sunday s game with something to prove out of the gate starting their third and second stints as head coaches respectively mccarthy benefits from having a familiar friend at the controls of his offense in greybeard aaron rodgers stefanski on the other hand spent the summer playing coy about who his starting qb would be between tua tagovailoa and michael penix the latter who boasts more upside only returned to practice two weeks ago leaving tagovailoa as stefanki s only true option against pittsburgh specified as only a week 1 starter tua appears to have a short leash in atlanta about as long as penix s recovery or 60 minutes on sunday rodgers did not play at all in the preseason so rust for the tinfoil man is a possibility but once he warms up the four time mvp should have his way with michael pittman dk metcalf and pat freiermuth against a falcons pass rush neutered by the loss of second year standouts jalon walker injury and james pearce suspension editor s update atlanta ruled tua tagovailoa oblique out of sunday s game making cooper rush the falcons starting quarterback vs the steelers why jeremy picked the jets don t call it a revenge game at least that s what robert saleh and aaron glenn are preaching ahead of the former s first game as head coach against his former team both tennessee and new york are keeping the main thing the main thing which is rebounding from an awful 2025 with a week 1 victory something that eluded each side the last two campaigns in fact the only first week win from either organization since 2021 came in aaron rodgers infamous four snap debut which in case you memory holed it ended in an overtime win for saleh s jets in short a week 1 victory for tennessee or new york is rare and should be cherished on the titans defensive front ex jets jermaine johnson and john franklin myers will surely be licking their chops to stick it to their old squad alongside all world dt jeffery simmons but the jets are as well equipped on offense as they ve been in years their offensive line is sturdy and consistent and their weapons finally go two deep and while cam ward s first unit struggled this preseason geno smith and co flourished in their limited action a veteran gang green squad has just enough to outlast this green tennessee team it won t be pretty but it s week 1 when nothing is more stylish than a 1 0 record why jeremy picked the chargers in what figures to be the most lopsided result of week 1 outside of duval county the chargers are in prime position to get off to an electric start our brief glimpses of justin herbert in mike mcdaniel s offense this summer were straight gas and as long as jake slaughter holds up at center in his first career start against walter nolen josh sweat and arizona s pass rush los angeles should carry that momentum into the regular season with ease first year head coach mike lafleur vs football lifer jim harbaugh is not a fair fight at least not in week 1 i see a big halftime lead dwindling down the stretch as jacoby brissett trey mcbride michael wilson and co play well from behind as they so often did in 2025 but the result will never be in doubt bolts big why brooke picked the raiders the raiders drew the long end of the stick by hosting the dolphins in the opener there are question marks littered throughout miami s 2026 roster specifically on the offensive side of the ball rb de 39 von achane is in position to carry another heavy load this season as qb malik willis navigates his first campaign as a full time starter with a wr corps that s royally inexperienced there s potential there looking at you caleb douglas and chris bell but the success won t happen overnight expect the raiders defense to force willis to beat them through the air which won t be an easy feat with maxx crosby back in tow the raiders have fewer question marks and more talent across the board the offense appears better than the unit that scored a league low 14 2 points per game with geno smith in 2025 kirk cousins has the reins for now and his steady quarterbacking will be a warm welcome for raiders fans near and far plus ashton jeanty ankle should be good to go on sunday and brock bowers is primed to do more brock bowers things in year 3 editor s update after publishing on wednesday nfl network insider ian rapoport reported that brock bowers underwent a meniscus trim on tuesday and is expected to miss a game or two one final note from the nfl research team this is the sixth game in the last 30 seasons in which both head coaches are making their nfl debuts with the home coach winning three of the previous five such games that s another aspect that bodes well for klint kubiak why brooke picked the vikings how will kyler murray look under kevin o connell s tutelage we re about to find out in what will be a rocking u s bank stadium full of vikings fans ready to forget the qb conundrum of 2025 as a vikings fan myself i don t feel as if the qb play can get worse than what i witnessed last season i sure hope that s true these nfc north matchups are always competitive but this particular one feels more about what the packers lost this offseason than what the vikings gained green bay begins the 2026 campaign without superstar pass rusher micah parsons and rb josh jacobs an instrumental part of matt lafleur s offense in recent seasons who s currently on the commissioner s exempt list that backfield will now feature marshawn lloyd kaleb johnson and chris brooks the only one with more than 100 career rush yards meaning brian flores defense should expect a heavy dose of jordan love s arm ultimately missing two big time starters will be too much to overcome for the road team why gennaro picked the eagles this matchup would have garnered a whole lot more attention in week 1 of last season when it could ve served as an instant rematch of the previous campaign s nfc title game but these two division rivals have gone in different directions since they met on championship sunday back in late january of 2025 philadelphia of course went on to win its second super bowl that february and although the eagles dealt with their fair share of drama this past season they still became the nfc east s first repeat winners in 21 years washington meanwhile completely came apart in 2025 injuries spoiled jayden daniels sophomore effort while dan quinn s defense gave up the most yards in the league gm adam peters aggressively rebuilt the commanders d in free agency and the draft but i m not convinced that ll be a quick fix more concerningly i have serious doubts about daniels supporting cast especially the laremy tunsil less offensive line that s a recipe for disaster against vic fangio s defense sure the eagles edge group has question marks but the front is spearheaded by the devastating dt duo of jalen carter and jordan davis even if jayden can avoid those 650 pounds of pain philly has two athletic linebackers zack baun and jihaad campbell to track the fleet footed quarterback and a pair of first team all pro cover men quinyon mitchell and cooper dejean to close his passing lanes nick sirianni improves to 6 0 in week 1 why brooke picked the giants i know the cowboys have dominated this division rivalry recently winning 16 of their last 18 meetings going back to 2017 despite new york prevailing in week 18 last season dallas pulled its starters at halftime but this game feels like a massive opportunity for the giants to course correct after an offseason full of change john harbaugh is captaining the ship cam skattebo is healthy malik nabers could be on the verge of returning after missing a majority of last season odell beckham is back and no 5 overall draft pick arvell reese joined one of the league s scariest pass rushes at least on paper so yeah these aren t last year s giants these aren t last year s cowboys either dallas defense which ranked dead last in scoring d and 30th in yards allowed in 2025 was overhauled in the offseason with a new coordinator christian parker and an influx of talent including a pair of first round rookies in caleb downs and malachi lawrence that unit has plenty to prove so too does an offensive line that was put under some extra pressure this week with the injury to pro bowl lg tyler smith a development that throws fourth year pro tj bass into the fire you can t get all caught up in the statistical weeds for week 1 because we don t truly know what the 2026 iterations of these clubs look like i have to lean into the vibes and my gut we re talking prime time at metlife this just feels like big blue s super bowl monday sept 14 why jeremy picked the broncos there is so much intrigue going into this week 1 finale that i m almost embarrassed by my curiosity with the most overexposed nfl franchise of the past half decade but that s what patrick mahomes does his absence magnifies his presence could he actually be all the way back from last year s devastating knee injury was 2025 the fluke of flukes or a harbinger of something worse to come for andy reid and friends similarly for denver is bo nix all healed and ready to take mahomes mantle as king of the division or was his first year atop the west an illusion of how things could be monday night won t provide definitive answers but it should feature solid if unremarkable play for both sides mahomes will knock off the rust the broncos will play well but keep kansas city around with turnovers and a fourth quarter score perhaps by offseason addition jaylen waddle will fittingly be the deciding factor no shootout in the first wild afc west matchup of the season but last year s trends outsized broncos success chiefs woes in one score games will make their mark on this year s opener wednesday s game why dan picked the seahawks i m expecting a much more competitive contest than what we saw when the patriots and seahawks met in february a 29 13 shellacking by seattle mainly because i have concerns about the condition of the hawks run game and the back end of the defense as you might recall those two facets played leading roles in propelling mike macdonald s team to the top last season the sb lx mvp kenneth walker departed in the offseason and zach charbonnet is on the pup list that means rookie jadarian price and third year pro george holani who has made his bones on special teams so far will be asked to carry the bulk of the rushing load are they up to the challenge against a defense that didn t allow a 100 yard rusher until week 12 last season also the seahawks lost safety coby bryant and corner riq woolen in free agency they will be without starting safety ty okada while nickelback nick emmanwori is questionable to play as he returns from ankle surgery any coverage breakdowns as the new secondary gains its footing could be costly against an offense undoubtedly anxious to feature marquee offseason acquisition a j brown ultimately i don t trust the patriots offensive line last seen being ripped to shreds by seattle s fearsome front enough to pick the upset but i do believe in oc josh mcdaniels promise that the rematch will be different thursday s game why bobby picked the 49ers it s nearly impossible to enter a campaign with as much hype as the rams los angeles was already enjoying a promising offseason having added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson when general manager les snead swung a trade for the single season sack king myles garrett it was such a seismic move that three time defensive player of the year aaron donald came out of retirement can such exultant vibes carry over to the field in week 1 which is often a toss up anyway after a roughly 16 hour flight to australia i m not sold there s a lot of injury or load management situations to consider on both sides george kittle nick bosa garrett donald not traveling to australia etc so that doesn t necessarily move the needle on rosters that are formidable with or without a few of the bigger stars the kyle shanahan AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

material_news_signals.headline: Broncos' Courtland Sutton: Bo Nix has been 'like a mountain lion' awaiting his Week 1 return
material_news_signals.description: With all the attention on Patrick Mahomes returning for the Kansas City Chiefs on Monday night at Arrowhead Stadium, Bo Nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat, but the Denver Broncos quarterback feels ready to roll.
material_news_signals.body_text: with all the attention on patrick mahomes returning for the kansas city chiefs on monday night at arrowhead stadium bo nix getting back on the field has taken a backseat the denver broncos quarterback missed the afc championship game after suffering a right ankle fracture late in a divisional round win over buffalo the prevailing theory is that had nix been healthy the broncos would have been playing in santa clara for the super bowl in february the qb has been cleared for most of the offseason last month he participated in 14 preseason snaps dipping his toe in the water nix s full return comes monday night in prime time as the broncos set out to defend their afc west title i m just excited to get out there nix said via the team s official website i feel like i m pacing and feel like i ve been in this practice schedule for a long time it s exciting to go out there and play another team it s really exciting and i know that our guys are going to respond well i feel like i have a great group with me that i m going in here with i can t wait in two seasons nix has not missed a passing snap in his regular season career and denver was the only team not to have a backup qb attempt a pass in 2024 and 2025 per nfl research receiver courtland sutton said nix s eagerness to return is obvious he s a competitor now sutton said i m looking forward to watching him go out there he s like a mountain lion that s in the zoo that s just pacing i saw a mountain lion at the colorado zoo he was just pacing back and forth and i was like y all don t want that boy to get out it s not going to be good that s what bo reminds me of nix has led the broncos to 24 career wins tied for the most over a player s first two seasons since 1950 russell wilson denver is 3 1 versus the chiefs with nix as a starter having lost the first matchup before taking the next three the club was 1 15 versus k c from 2016 2023 before drafting nix in 2024 the afc west champs starting the season off on the road won t be an easy first step in their effort to repeat but it s probably better to play mahomes at arrowhead early in his return rather than later

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: 49ers rookie WR De'Zhaun Stribling out at least a month with ankle sprain
news_mentions.description: The 49ers will be without their top rookie for at least a quarter of the 2026 season. First-year receiver De'Zhaun Stribling is out at least a month after suffering a deltoid sprain in his ankle.
news_mentions.body_text: the 49ers will be without their top rookie for at least a quarter of the 2026 season first year receiver de 39 zhaun stribling is out at least a month after suffering a deltoid sprain in his ankle nfl network insider ian rapoport reported sunday per sources stribling is still seeking medical opinions and surgery is an option though not currently planned rapoport added the rookie wr suffered the injury in the first quarter of the 49ers season opening win over the rams in melbourne australia this past week stribling left the game in the second quarter without a target on 21 snaps san francisco selected stribling with the first pick of the second round of the 2026 nfl draft its first overall selection stribling s setback is the 49ers latest significant injury just as they were getting healthier ricky pearsall is already out for the season having undergone knee surgery in august defensive tackle alfred collins tore his patellar tendon during practice in australia and tight end jake tonges left the rams game with a knee injury george kittle and nick bosa just returned to game action this week from their 2025 season ending injuries without the rookie in brock purdy s receiving corps demarcus robinson deebo samuel and jacob cowing are slated for more action than expected early on newcomer mike evans led all 49ers wideouts with 48 snaps against l a followed by robinson 40 and samuel 26 san francisco 1 0 hosts the dolphins in its home opener on sept 20 at 4 25 p m et

news_mentions.body_text: melbourne australia for the second straight season the san francisco 49ers beat the los angeles rams on the road thanks to a critical goal line stand a year ago it was defensive tackle alfred collins knocking the ball from kyren williams 39 grip before the running back crossed into the end zone on thursday it was a team effort that prevented matthew stafford from crossing the goal line and cutting san francisco 39 s lead to three the 49ers held onto the ball longer than the rams 33 50 vs 26 10 and committed fewer penalties two to four only six infractions perhaps that 39 s why the game wrapped up in a tidy 2 hours and 47 minutes the 49ers offense was on the field for 65 plays the defense for 61 here 39 s how the individual snaps were doled out quarterback brock purdy 65 purdy 39 s most remarkable statistic might have been his average depth of target adot which was only 4 9 yards his average is usually double that number the reason was the flurry of screen plays san francisco ran likely called to slow down edge rushers myles garrett and byron young purdy attempted 11 screens and completed 10 for 40 yards by contrast the 49ers attempted one screen in their previous meeting with the rams in week 10 last season running back christian mccaffrey 36 kyle juszczyk fullback 33 kaelon black 28 deebo samuel 2 black 39 s 65 rushing yards stood out for a team that 39 s been loath to give rookie runners many opportunities however it wasn 39 t the most for a week 1 rookie under kyle shanahan in the 2021 opener then rookie elijah mitchell finished with 104 yards in a win at detroit mccaffrey who averaged just 3 9 yards a carry last season averaged 6 8 per run against the rams that included runs of 14 and 16 yards in the second half wide receiver mike evans 49 demarcus robinson 41 samuel 25 de 39 zhaun stribling 21 jacob cowing 5 khadarel hodge 1 evans 39 first three catches came on third downs when he was lined up out of the slot and all were converted into first downs evans and stribling started the game at wideout stribling and linebacker jaden dugger were the only rookie starters although black offensive lineman carver willis and defensive linemen romello height gracen halton and james thompson also got into the game tight end luke farrell 46 george kittle 30 jake tonges 8 kittle 39 s return to the lineup following his january achilles tear was one of the big stories leading up to the game but blocking specialist farrell ended up with more receiving yards 19 to kittle 39 s 12 including a critical 14 yarder when the 49ers were backed up against their own goal line 34 it was clutch for luke to have that catch and getting us out of there 34 purdy said shanahan said tonges 39 knee injury which occurred in the second quarter 34 wasn 39 t good 34 34 it 39 s not an acl it 39 s an mcl i believe 34 shanahan said 34 but there are some issues with it we got to see how it is 34 if tonges misses some time the 49ers likely will bring brayden willis back to the active roster from the practice squad another option is rookie practice squad tight end khalil dinkins offensive line trent williams 65 connor colby 65 jake brendel 65 dominick puni 65 colton mckivitz 65 there was speculation before the game that colby might rotate at left guard with carver willis instead willis played six snaps of special teams colby held up well in pass protection surrendering one quarterback hit and one quarterback hurry thanks in part to the quick passing game the 49ers surrendered no sacks and allowed just eight quarterback pressures defensive line osa odighizuwa 36 nick bosa 36 halton 31 height 30 keion white 30 cj west 23 thompson 21 khalid kareem 19 ogbo okoronkwo 18 west opened his second season starting the game at defensive tackle next to odighizuwa but halton the fourth round rookie outsnapped him 31 to 23 halton and odighizuwa were the defensive tackles on the pivotal fourth down goal line stand in the third quarter odighizuwa was credited for the tackle though it seemed to be a group effort linebacker fred warner 53 dre greenlaw 40 dugger 34 garret wallow 13 warner 39 s 11 tackles give him 958 for his career surpassing patrick willis for the most in franchise history the 49ers used a five man defensive line 12 times against the rams all of them with dugger a 6 5 242 pound linebacker serving as the fifth lineman tatum bethune was inactive for the game likely because wallow is a better special teamer wallow entered as the team 39 s middle linebacker when the outcome was out of reach cornerback deommodore lenoir 61 renardo green 61 upton stout 36 jack jones 8 green battling a hamstring strain in the run up to the game made a crucial interception in the second quarter and drew praise from shanahan after the game green had a down year last season he finished with no interceptions and famously got dressed down by shanahan on the sideline during a playoff loss in seattle 34 he had such a good training camp phase one and otas 34 shanahan said thursday 34 he was one of the guys i was most excited about this year just in terms of taking such a big step from the year before and he had that hamstring which set him back and he wasn 39 t able to go until this week he was working all week to get up and for him to be healthy enough to play through that game make it through the game without getting an injury and to play at the level he did i thought was huge 34 safety marques sigle 61 ji 39 ayir brown 55 malik mustapha 6 sigle had a strong outing finishing second to warner with nine tackles including a couple in which he flew in from the secondary to cut down a rams ball carrier just as he was getting up to speed brown however misjudged a 41 yard pass to puka Niners-Rams in Australia: What We Learned from San Francisco's 27-7 win
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Grant Gordon breaks down the top takeaways from the San Francisco 49ers' 27-7 win over the Los Angeles Rams in Australia.
news_mentions.body_text: niners burst rams bubble lying in wait for an upset in australia the 49ers stunned the nfl s most hyped squad and their division rivals new faces mike evans returning talents fred warner and familiar standouts brock purdy came to play and make a statement kyle shanahan largely carved up the rams revarnished defense with purdy throwing three touchdowns passes and for 205 yards in front of 100 021 fans attending the nfl s first ever regular season game in australia though they only collected three points the 49ers opening drive set a stellar tone with purdy guiding them 65 yards on 15 plays completing 9 of 12 passes with christian mccaffrey rookie kaelon black george kittle returning from an achilles injury deebo samuel returning after spending 2025 with the commanders and evans all catching balls an absolute beauty of a 39 yard td pass to former rams wr demarcus robinson led to a precarious 10 7 halftime lead for the 49ers but in the second half purdy and co squeezed the life out of the rams purdy s 15 yard score to deebo samuel culminated an 11 play 99 yard td march to open the fourth quarter and close out a statement making week 1 win you can t hold a funeral or throw a party based off a week 1 result but this was a dominant win for san francisco against a super bowl favorite that has been everyone s offseason darling the 49ers aren t to be overlooked in the nfc rams fall flat in much anticipated opener when the rams received the opening kickoff they did so as the first team in league chronicle with the reigning ap nfl mvp matthew stafford and the reigning defensive player of the year myles garrett by the time the game ended both symbolized the rams shocking lack of production from their galaxy of all stars stafford was dismal unable to get the rams the league s top scoring offense last season into any rhythm he threw for just 155 yards with no touchdowns an interception and a 61 2 rating the seven points in the loss marked just the second stafford start for the rams with 10 points or fewer scored the other was a week 4 loss to the 49ers in 2022 having won the mvp after leading the league with 46 touchdowns stafford had at least one td pass in every game last season stafford s zero tds were matched by garrett s tackles as the longtime browns standout recorded just his fourth career game out of 135 with zero tackles niners offensive tackle trent williamsboat raced garrett in their heavyweight showdown garrett was credited by five qb pressures one coming in 11 matchups with williams per next gen stats with aaron donald back home in los angeles he had just about as much statistical impact for the new look rams d as garrett a long season still lies ahead but this is l a s first loss by more than seven points since week 12 2024 there were few positives to take from this one other than there being 16 games left in the regular season for the rams to prove they re not paper champions which will surely be the too quick too hot take as they re flying home evans makes phenomenal introduction there was no shortage of shiny new additions for the 49ers or rams to unveil in the season opener mike evans 49ers debut proved to be the most pivotal as the 33 year old looked every bit like the six time pro bowler he was with the buccaneers in his first game playing in a different uniform evans was clutch and in classic form highlighted by a 2 yard touchdown reception in the third quarter off a brock purdy fade it was evans 37th career td catch of 5 yards or fewer tying him for second all time per nfl research he finished tied for the game high with six receptions for 49 yards he had three third down conversions on the 49ers opening drive san francisco wasted little time letting it be known evans will be a big part of its plans but shanahan likewise showcased balance that was missing last year christian mccaffrey 10 carries for 68 yards and kaelon black 14 for 65 split reps while three 49ers caught td passes and six had multiple catches new and old faces meshed quickly mcvay s flux capacitor fails him for first time the rams departed southern california on tuesday night and arrived in melbourne australia on thursday morning roughly a day before kickoff on friday morning aussie time sean mcvay and the rams travel plan in comparison to kyle shanahan and the 49ers taking ample time to arrive and get acclimated drew criticism and will garner more for the first time mcvay s travel itinerary failed him the rams did a quick turn and burn for a 35 7 win over the jacksonville jaguars last season in london arriving just a day ahead of the game with mcvay improving to 3 0 in international games but mcvay lost for the first time in an international game l a looked sluggish to start punting on its first two drives after never having multiple punts in the first quarter last season once matthew stafford hit puka nacua for a 41 yard gain late in the first the rams seemed to be ignited with kyren williams scoring two plays later however they never got out of the offensive mud they left late and they left for home early as stafford hit the bench when l a took over possession late in the fourth conceding the loss defensive returns make difference on the first play from scrimmage matthew stafford was pressured by nick bosa before throwing a pass that was almost picked off by fred warner bosa torn acl and warner ankle were absent for much of last season and their returns beyond just the stat sheets so clearly buoyed san francisco the rams were the top offense in scoring and yards last year but were held to seven points and 290 yards in this one had two turnovers and were stuffed on two of three fourth down attempts warner had a game high 11 tackles while bosa had a four tackles two for loss san francisco got gashed a few times on the run but overall this was a marvelous performance in raheem morris first game as defensive coordinator and no doubt bolstered by the return of two of the nfl s elite talents nfl pro insight for 49ers rams brock purdy s 39 yard touchdown to demarcus robinson traveled 44 yards relative to the line of scrimmage for the longest completion by air yards in purdy s career nfl research sean mcvay lost his first international series game falling to 3 1 his three international victories as a head coach trail only doug pederson s four

news_mentions.headline: NFC West training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for 49ers, Cardinals, Rams, Seahawks
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC West training camp storylines to monitor for the Arizona Cardinals, Los Angeles Rams, San Francisco 49ers and Seattle Seahawks.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers and seattle seahawks catch up on each nfc west team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below arizona cardinals los angeles rams san francisco 49ers seattle seahawks three key storylines 1 sorting out brissett s contract drama installing rookie head coach mike lafleur s offense certainly hasn t gone off without a hitch jacoby brissett who took the quarterbacking reins from an injured kyler murray last season and never gave them back is the presumed starter and wants to get paid like one having skipped voluntary workouts brissett reported for mandatory minicamp to avoid fines but just how much actual work he got in isn t all that apparent will brissett hold out or hold in during training camp that threatens to become a prevailing topic in arizona even if it all gets sorted out the whole matter of getting ready for the football season remains lafleur has downplayed brissett s lack of offseason involvement citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

material_news_signals.description: The 49ers will be without their top rookie for at least a quarter of the 2026 season. First-year receiver De'Zhaun Stribling is out at least a month after suffering a deltoid sprain in his ankle.
